title: PMV experiment store identity, version 1
description: <root>/store.v1.json: the permanent, read-only (0400) identity of one experiment store, created once with the ledger of a pristine store and never changed. Ledger entry 0 (ledger_created) records the same store_id, and pending-repair marker names include it. Documentation only: the authoritative validator is pmv.experiments.ExperimentStore._read_store_id. Canonical bytes: sorted keys, no spaces, ASCII, no floats, one trailing newline. JSON booleans are never integers.
